summary: Frontend-only verification of new WorldMapSection on Home (/). All acceptance criteria met: section renders with title + SVG world map (174 paths), Morocco is the only interactive country (terracotta #6E2D17 → #8A3A1E on hover, cursor:pointer), other countries have pointer-events:none, Morocco label + ocean labels visible, /geo/countries-110m.json returns 200. Clicking the Morocco path, the 'Marruecos' label and the 'Descubrir Marruecos' CTA all navigate to /que-ver-en-Marruecos. Responsive at 1440/768/390 with no overflow. Zero console errors / warnings (no duplicate-key warning).
critical_code_review_comments: WorldMapSection.jsx: minor — labelW heuristic (length*8.4+26) is brittle for long translations; consider measuring text via getBBox or using a flexbox HTML overlay if labels grow. Currently fine for ES/EN/FR.
WorldMapSection.jsx: hover state shared between path and label via React state is fine, but the rect/text inside the label group could also reflect hover for stronger affordance.
Accessibility: the label <g> is clickable but has no role/tabIndex/aria-label — only the path does. Consider mirroring role='button', tabIndex=0 and keyboard handler on the label for parity.
Performance: 170+ <path> nodes render fine, but `feature(topo, ...)` recomputes on every topo change — acceptable since topo loads once. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WorldMapSection lives in HomePage.jsx between <EmotionalIntro/> and <VideoSection ...story/>. Testids: home-world-map, world-map-morocco, world-map-morocco-label, world-map-cta. Topojson at /geo/countries-110m.json. All three click targets navigate via pathFor(lang,'whatToSee') → ES: /que-ver-en-Marruecos.
